tasks.label: case 2: historical technical rationale
tasks.prompt: Why is the initial retry delay in src/retry.js 300 ms instead of 1 second? Reply briefly, or UNKNOWN if you cannot determine it.

seed.title: Retry delay rationale
seed.body: Rationale for the 300 ms initial retry delay (2026-05-03, INC-222): the upstream load balancer drops idle TLS connections after 250 ms, so the first retry must start before that; 300 ms keeps margin. sources: incident-222.md
